newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 754,200 MT were 22 percent more than the prior week, but 12 percent less than the 4-week average. Major increases for South Korea (164,000 MT, including 2,000 in new sales and 162,000 in destination changes), Spain (147,100 MT including 97,100 in new sales and 50,000 in destination changes), China (144,100 MT including 6,900 in new sales, 140,000 in destination changes and 2,800 in cancellations), the Netherlands (140,900 MT), and Belgium (120,600 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (294,600 MT) and Japan (145,300 MT).
Exports of 980,400 MT--a marketing-year high--were 9 percent above the previous week and 13 percent above the 4-week average.
The primary destinations were China (249,100 MT), the Netherlands (109,000 MT), Mexico (97,200 MT), and Japan (73,400 MT).
